sloka: शुश्रूषुर् जननीम् पुत्र स्व गृहे नियतः वसन् ।परेण तपसा युक्तः काश्यपः त्रिदिवम् गतः ॥२-२१-२३॥
transliteration: śuśrūṣur jananīm putra sva gṛhe niyataḥ vasan ।pareṇa tapasā yuktaḥ kāśyapaḥ tridivam gataḥ ॥2-21-23॥

translations.english: O son Kasyapa who led a life of selfdiscipline and served his mother at home, attained heaven credited with (the merit of) the highest penance.
